assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and the three key areas use provisional rough geometry (provisional_constraint) until official polygons are published by the organizer.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, layer synchronisation, figures, PDFs, and HTML metrics must be recomputed by tools/recompute_metrics.py and tools/generate_figures.py when official polygons replace the provisional ones; values in this submission are design-discussion values only.

assumptions.statement: The seven global cases (King's Cross, Kendall Square, Station F, Marunouchi, Jurong Lake District, Pangyo, Hetao) are cited for mechanism translation only; their operational data, land institutions, and fiscal arrangements are not transplantable.
assumptions.impact: Case facts are per each public source (see sources.json CASE-* entries); any subsequent claim based on a case must return to that source and be re-cleared.

assumptions.statement: All scenario and operation KPIs (e.g. events per year, participants, conversion counts) are conceptual indicators for design discussion, not committed targets.
assumptions.impact: KPIs must not be presented as confirmed government commitments; they calibrate design intent and will be replaced by operation-side data if piloted.

assumptions.statement: Annual events, developer community, scenario opening, and international communication mechanisms require public-space permits, event safety filings, and copyright clearance before any operation.
assumptions.impact: The proposal contains no confirmed event calendar or operational commitment; all listed activities are conceptual suggestions.

assumptions.statement: Heritage symbols (platform numbers, gauge lines, milestone stones), historical imagery, and cultural narratives must be confirmed with heritage authorities and rights holders before use.
assumptions.impact: No historical fact or image is asserted as official; L1-L3 pilgrimage landmarks and wayfinding symbols remain conceptual until clearance.

assumptions.statement: Inclusive design (older adults, children, people with disabilities, low-income residents, caregivers, non-smart-device users) follows accessibility standards, with offline equivalent services, appeal channels, and annual third-party manual inspection.
assumptions.impact: Accessibility inspection reports and appeal timelines are design mechanisms; formal compliance is verified during implementation.
